Name: VJster
Description: Ride the speed and quality of the video playing in Chrome from your Stream Deck: dials for speed, fine nudge and FX speed, keys for presets, play/pause and tab pinning. Works with the VJster Chrome extension; nothing leaves this computer.

com.jbrick2070.vjster.speed.Name: Speed
com.jbrick2070.vjster.speed.Tooltip: Turn for speed, hold and turn for fine steps, press for 1x, tap the strip to play or pause.

com.jbrick2070.vjster.quality.Name: Quality
com.jbrick2070.vjster.quality.Tooltip: Turn to step through the video's quality levels, press or tap for Auto. YouTube only.

com.jbrick2070.vjster.speed-preset.Name: Speed Preset
com.jbrick2070.vjster.speed-preset.Tooltip: One fixed speed. Lights up while it is the speed playing.

com.jbrick2070.vjster.speed-step.Name: Speed Step
com.jbrick2070.vjster.speed-step.Tooltip: Faster or slower by one step.

com.jbrick2070.vjster.quality-preset.Name: Quality Preset
com.jbrick2070.vjster.quality-preset.Tooltip: One fixed quality level, or Auto. Dimmed when the video does not offer it.

com.jbrick2070.vjster.pin.Name: Pin Tab
com.jbrick2070.vjster.pin.Tooltip: Keep controlling the current Chrome tab, whatever else plays. Press again to let go.

Localization._comment: VJster's English texts, the source for every other language. Written with Claude Opus 5.5 (an AI model); see docs/vjster/INSTALL.md for how to send corrections.

pi.fieldHoldSpeed: Keep the speed on the next video
pi.fieldHoldLevel: Keep the level on the next video
pi.fieldDirect: Write the video directly (needed below 0.25x or above 4x)
pi.pinNote: Press to keep controlling the Chrome tab that is active now; press again to let go.
pi.extensionNote: Leave empty to accept any Chrome extension, or paste the id the VJster extension shows in its options. Everything stays on this computer.
pi.statusWaiting: No Chrome extension is connected. Open Chrome with the VJster extension. The port must be the same here and in the extension's options.
pi.statusPortInUse: Port {port} is in use. Another program with VJster may be running: Fadester for OBS, the VJster plugin or Fadester Companion. Keep only one.
pi.noValidId: No entry is a Chrome extension id: no extension can connect
pi.badIdOne: {n} entry ignored: not a Chrome extension id
pi.badIdMany: {n} entries ignored: not a Chrome extension id
pi.noObsPage: This copy of the plugin has no OBS page
pi.keepOnNote: OBS loads the page only when it starts or when the source is refreshed, so the link stays on while Stream Deck runs. This turns on by itself the first time an OBS page connects.
pi.obsNote: In OBS, add a Browser source, untick Local file, and paste this address as its URL. Then set an action's Control to OBS page or Both. The address carries this computer's OBS page key: keep it out of screenshots and chat.
pi.languageNote: Applies to all VJster controls. Stream Deck's own menus, action list, tooltips and dial hints stay in Stream Deck's language. The OBS page and the Chrome extension keep their own language.
